# A stalagmite: a tall 6-sided spire 1.15 m with two shorter ones leaning on it, on a rubble
# skirt. Stone (slate, shading to the dark, the sun side up to pale). Origin on the floor under the
# big spire. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Stone --base-color 0.2667 0.3020 0.5176 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Spire --vertices 6 --radius1 0.3 --radius2 0.05 --depth 1.15 --location 0 0 0.575
add mesh cone --name SpireB --vertices 6 --radius1 0.2 --radius2 0.03 --depth 0.7 --location 0.22 -0.12 0.3 --rotation -8 14 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cone --name SpireC --vertices 5 --radius1 0.16 --radius2 0.03 --depth 0.5 --location -0.2 0.1 0.22 --rotation 10 -16 0
apply --rotation
add mesh ico-sphere --name Skirt --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.42 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 0.35
apply --scale
select Spire SpireB SpireC Skirt
active Spire
join
# the joined object's origin is the spire's centre (z 0.575): world coordinates first, so the cut
# below takes the faces under the floor (select ... where reads object-local positions)
apply --location
material assign Stone
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < 0.0"
delete only-faces
select all
randomize --amount 0.025 --seed 9
mode object
shade flat
export stalagmite.glb
